items.html: *And we will clarify the matter of the head of the fetus, what its meaning is. For behold, the head is the vessels of the Mochin, in the secret of the cavities of the Galgalta, as above. And behold, we said that it has in it as yet only two Mochin, which are the two Elokim. And it is known that the Elokim of Hochma is in the filling of Yudin, which is 300 in gematria. And the Elokim of Bina is in the aspect of the simple posteriors of the Name Elokim, like this: Alef; Alef-Lamed; Alef-Lamed-Heh; Alef-Lamed-Heh-Yod; Alef-Lamed-Heh-Yod-Mem, which is 200 in gematria, as is written in the matter of nursing. And these two aspects are the Shin and Resh of the word Rosh, and the extra Alef is the inclusion. However, the aspect of Daat he does not yet have, as above. And after the matter of the Mochin of pregnancy has been clarified, we will now clarify when they are made.
